label: TransactionAttemptContext (Java SDK)
type: the transaction-scoped CRUD/query API (ctx.insert/get/replace/remove/query) whose writes are staged and invisible to other actors until the transaction commits
promotion_reason: promoted below the usual 2-file recurrence bar for semantic significance, in line with the judgment-call exception used for hasNoRelationshipTo in round 3 - this is the concrete mechanism behind round 4's headline finding. Replace/remove require a prior ctx.get() purely so 'the SDK can check that the document is not involved in another transaction' - a transaction-membership check, structurally distinct from sdk:cas-optimistic-locking's per-operation CAS-token comparison. No CAS/CasMismatch language appears anywhere in the source page.
note: Do not conflate with ordinary Collection-API CRUD calls (sdk:kv-operations) - the source page states plainly that regular Collection operations must never be used inside a transaction lambda; ctx's operations are the required substitute (see relations/must-use-instead-when.json).
